Title: Implement company get api. Review only this checkout at HEAD. Do not build or run tests. Reply with the full review report.

expected.text: companySchema still requires `ownerName` as a non-optional field, but the PR removed `ownerName` from the Company type and from `prepareForValidation` in company-detail.config.ts. When the user tries to save company details via the edit sidebar, Zod will always return a validation error ('Owner name is required') because the field is never provided to the schema. The schema was not updated to match the new data model.

formattedCompanyData is only populated when `Array.isArray(apiData)` is true. The code also explicitly handles the case where `(apiData as any)?.total` exists (suggesting the API may return a paginated wrapper object like `{results: [...], total: N}`). If the API does return a non-array wrapper, `(Array.isArray(apiData) ? apiData : []).map(...)` yields `[]`, so formattedCompanyData will be empty while totalItems is correctly set. This results in a pagination bar showing N items with zero rows displayed — silent data loss.

The `location` field is `editable: true` with `type: 'text'`, meaning users can type anything into it. The backend stores it as a WKT POINT string, but the schema (`cleanString` with min 2 chars) does not validate the WKT format. A user can enter a plain string like 'Mumbai', which passes validation and saves, but the map view falls back to showing raw text (`

` element) with no error feedback. The schema should validate WKT format, or the field should be made non-editable.

The Company type now omits `ownerName`, `email`, and `phone`, and `prepareForValidation` only returns `name`, `address`, `location`, and `type`. However, `companySchema` in `src/lib/schemas.ts` still defines `ownerName` as a required field (with `min(2)` validation) along with `email`/`phone`. As a result, validating a company edit through this detail config will always fail because `ownerName` is missing/empty. The `companySchema` needs to be updated to reflect the new Company shape (likely removing `ownerName`/`email`/`phone` and adding `description`), otherwise editing companies will be broken.

The add-company form no longer provides `ownerName`, `email`, or `phone`, but it still passes `companySchema`, which requires `ownerName`. CreationForm validates the whole schema against only the rendered fields, so submitting this modal will fail validation with an error for a field the user cannot fill.

The dialog-level `on:keydown|stopPropagation` prevents Escape key events from reaching the window handler whenever focus is inside the modal, so the advertised Escape-to-close behavior does not work for keyboard users after they interact with the dialog content.

This new label is propagated in the dashboard link, but `src/routes/company/dashboard/+page.svelte` only renders messages for `Validating`, `Verified`, and `Suspended`. Companies with backend status 1 will therefore arrive as `Under Verification` and show no status message on the dashboard unless the dashboard is updated or the label stays compatible.

Changing the dashboard URL to pass the raw `apiId` breaks the existing company-scoped dashboard pages: they read `?id=` and compare it directly to dummy data `companyId` values such as `COMP-001` (for example `src/routes/company/operator-account/+page.svelte:33`). Passing `1` instead of `COMP-1`/`COMP-001` makes those pages filter to empty results.
